name: Prince Rebeus
source:
An ancient name of the Lusanti. Rebeus is favoured by the [url=https://vndb.org/c165578]King[/url] for the crown. Rebeus would rather get drunk and chase women than rule. While considered the most desirable man in the kingdom, Rebeus has a growing reputation for humiliating women.
